item.title: BTS’ RM partners with SFMOMA, co-curating landmark ‘RM x SFMOMA’ art exhibition
item.description: BTS' RM is bringing his passion for visual art to one of the most important modern museums in the world with an exhibition that blurs the lines between personal passion and public presentation. item.title: Sentosa beach club Tipsy Unicorn closes after High Court winds up operator Tipsy Bird
item.description: Sentosa’s nightlife circuit has lost one of its flashiest players. Tipsy Unicorn has ceased operations after the High Court ordered its operator, Tipsy Bird, to be wound up. According to reports, the court placed Tipsy Bird into compulsory liquidation following a winding-up application filed by United Overseas Bank (UOB) over outstanding debts. item.title: World’s #1 Michael Jackson tribute show 'This Is Michael' lands in Singapore this June
item.description: On 5 June, the world’s leading Michael Jackson tribute production, This Is Michael, will take over Capitol Theatre at Stamford Road for a one-night-only performance — promising a full-scale concert experience dedicated to the King of Pop.
